method: Visual inspection of timestamped contact sheets, 0.125-second sampling; selected contacts enlarged to 640 pixels. Not continuous playback or frame-exact ground truth.
taxonomy_decision: User explicitly requested that bicycle_kick include both overhead kicks and sideways scissors.
selection: All 43 previously uncertain clips and all 6 original-compilation other clips; not selected using model scores. HF negatives were not re-reviewed in this revision.
